title: Deep (tahom) leads to Water (mayim) — shared coloured letters
summary: The Hebrew word for 'deep', תהום (tahom), with a downward arrow to the Hebrew word for 'water', מיים (mayim). The letters are colour-coded so the light-blue final mem is visibly shared between the two words.

pictures.description: Two rows of words joined by a small light-blue down arrow: 'Deep tahom' with the Hebrew תהום (tav red, he black, vav orange, final mem light blue) above 'Water mayim' with the Hebrew מיים (mem light blue, two dark-red yods, final mem light blue).

uncertain: The Hebrew for water is shown as מיים (two yods) on this slide, whereas Genesis 1:2 on the previous slide has המים with one yod; transcribed as shown.
